name: variable-declared-with-with-var-including-error-test-1fe4adcb27/var-inferred-including-error-warnings-e.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: "Query expressions" supports "from", "where", "let", "join" (including outer join), "order by", "limit", "on conflict" and "select" clauses; query actions with do clauses are not listed.
## Statements: supported statement list includes "Local variable declarations", "Foreach" and "Return", but does not list do/on fail or fail statements.
## Expressions: standalone let expressions are not listed (let is listed only among query clauses).
### Other invocation restrictions: "error:message" and "value:toString" are supported method calls.
reason: Whole case requires unsupported/not-covered constructs: query actions ending in do {}, standalone let expressions, and do/fail/on fail handling. These are essential parts of this mixed negative-diagnostic case, even though ordinary declarations, error constructors, foreach over lists and the message/toString calls are supported.
unsupported_constructs: do statement with fail statement and on fail clause
Standalone let expressions in module and local initializers
test_design_notes: Many @error markers appear to represent original unused-variable warnings (including repeated markers on one line); the filename explicitly refers to warnings. Treating these as rejection assertions may misrepresent the original test.
Mixed scope: supported declaration/error-inference checks coexist with unsupported control-flow and expression forms.
